content: Community Blood Services is a blood bank that specializes in collecting blood donations. Additionally, it provides services such as cord blood banking and facilitates bone marrow registration and donations. Established in 1953, Community Blood Services operates as a not-for-profit organization based in Paramus, New Jersey. Its primary mission is to address the transfusion medicine needs of the community it serves. The organization supplies blood and blood products to 37 hospitals and medical centers located in Bergen, Passaic, Morris, Essex, and Hudson counties in New Jersey, as well as in New York City and the Rockland and Orange counties of New York. Community Blood Services is an active member of the American Association of Blood Banks and America's Blood Centers. Mission Statement: The organization is committed to enhancing the quality of healthcare in the communities it serves by continuously increasing the availability of blood and ensuring the provision of safe, high-quality transfusion products and services. Vision Statement: To deliver high-quality blood products to a greater number of patients. Mission Goals: To provide patients, physicians, and hospitals with reliable, high-quality transfusion products and services. To ensure the safety of blood donors by employing the most advanced and high-quality methods available.
